components.gap: Some of the source's definitions and distinctions are not reconstructed in the routed text. (a) Note 2 (printed p.314): Halpern (2003) calls these set functions 'plausibility measures' and does not even assume a total order on events (values in a partially ordered set); the authors warn this terminology may be confused with Shafer's plausibility functions. rationality-4-7.tex lines 20-23 gives only the Shafer side, dropping Halpern's terminology and the partial-order generalization; Halpern2003 appears only in \nocite (line 594). (b) Printed p.306: the naming lineage is missing: capacity (after Choquet 1953), fuzzy measure (after Sugeno 1977), confidence measure (Dubois-Prade 1988). Line 34 says only 'normalized capacity', and Choquet and Sugeno appear only in \nocite. (c) Printed p.308: the characterization of big-stepped probabilities as the discrete counterpart of exponential probability functions is not stated (rationality-4-7.tex lines 127-147; inductive-logic-and-confirmation-w02b-p15-032.tex lines 489-521). (d) Printed pp.308-309: the source's point that the axioms fix the meaning of the belief modality, from a loose reading ('the agent has received information that p') to a strong one ('the agent knows that p', in the sense of true belief), is not reconstructed.
